text:
Alex: quick RFC follow-up — proposing we extract precision selection + profiling into a separate lightweight service ("Precision Service") so runtime, ops, and model teams can iterate independently
Rachel: curious — is this mostly for separation of concerns or to enable cross-model sharing of profiles?
Alex: both. separation so the runtime stays thin; cross-model sharing (profiles, calibrations, degradation stats) and single place for per-customer overrides
Sam: main tradeoff i see: extra RPC hop on hotpath. we already have tight latency SLOs for chat endpoints
Alex: totally. design idea: local LRU cache in runtime for hot profiles + async refresh. decision path: if cache miss, consult precision svc but still allow default fallback in runtime to avoid p99 blowups
Mike: +1 on cache. need to quantify worst-case added latency on cold miss. can we batch profile lookups?
Ira: we can piggyback lookups on existing routing header exchange during session setup. one-time per session for chat; for single-shot generation we'd need inline lookup 
Leah: how about embedding profile id in model artifact metadata so runtime does simple id->profile cache lookup most of the time?
Alex: yes — plan is model artifacts carry a profile pointer (profile_id). runtime resolves pointer against cache; service only used for profile CRUD, audits, and cache refreshes
Rachel: operational concerns: ownership and SLA delegation. If precision service is down, does runtime revert to safe defaults? Who owns the emergency runbook?
Sam: runtime should degrade gracefully: fallback to full-precision or safe int8 profile depending on tenant. ops runbook should live with eng-platform but engage model owners for acceptance tests
Alex: agreed. proposed ownership: eng-platform owns service availability, eng-ml owns profile correctness & validation tests. we need oncall playbook mapping
Mike: metrics we need from day one: profile-lookup latency, cache hit rate, per-profile quality regression counts, per-customer deviation (degscore). Also histogram of last-successful-calibration timestamp
Ira: add: telemetry tag
